scope: Synthetic DOM/observer validation contract only; no game or Android acceptance

tests.name: Android embeds exactly the same fixed read-only DOM function
a rendered icon, seat and full real-ID-shaped text satisfy the observation contract
a 128-character ID is fully measured across wrapped lines
hidden ancestors cannot produce a false visible-ID pass
attribute-only IDs with missing rendered text are rejected
wrong seats are rejected even when the device ID matches
duplicate visible identity rows are rejected
Android capture wrapper naturally settles and binds read-only DOM before and after the PNG
connection loss during settling rejects capture before any screenshot
a changed seat after screenshot fails validation while retaining PNG metadata
browser capture keeps the existing screenshot path without Android settling or reads
status-only cannot silently combine with gameplay-only
